items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Abanis sent me a sock signal, Turkish signal.

ctx.x: Different kind of effect you want. That's a nice drum set. Any of these symbols, did you carry on the parades with you?

Well, no. That's a symbol, what we had. That's the Christ symbol, huh? In other words, give me an idea about what I'm talking about. See, that tum effect. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .

That's the sizzle, I call it a sizzle symbol sometimes, don't they? Right, right. It's like little rivets in there, isn't it? Yeah. Yeah, about a dozen, there are about eight little rivets in there. That's the turn. Let's see what make that is. That's a nice Turkish one, sounds good. I was wondering if it's one of the ziljins. I don't use a sizzle, do I have it?
